commentary.text: 90+3' That's it for today, Darren England has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.

90' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Southampton.

89' Taylor Harwood-Bellis (Southampton) wastes an opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
88' Southampton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
87' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise Alex McCarthy and he's equal to it.
87' Tottenham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
86' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Tottenham win a corner.
82' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Will Lankshear (Tottenham) replaces Dominic Solanke.
82' Adam Armstrong will be replaced by Cameron Archer (Southampton).
81' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Darren England interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
79' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
79' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
77' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute James Maddison and he is replaced by Timo Werner (Tottenham).
77' That will be all from Djed Spence who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Alfie Dorrington (Tottenham).
71' Darren England couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Djed Spence (Tottenham) and blew his whistle.

70' Close! Nathan Wood (Southampton) picks up the ball in space and from inside the penalty area sends a shot inches wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
69' The resulting corner from Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
68' Neat passing move from Southampton in order to create new attacking opportunities.

66' Kyle Walker-Peters (Southampton) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Tottenham will have a goal kick.
63' James Maddison (Tottenham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
63' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yukinari Sugawara (Southampton) is coming onto the pitch as Ryan Manning cannot continue after picking up an injury.
61' The corner from Ryan Manning (Southampton) is cleared away by the defence.
58' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
56' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Southampton will have a goal kick.
53' The linesman signals that Adam Armstrong (Southampton) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
53' The game is interrupted. James Maddison (Tottenham) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
50' Darren England shows a yellow card to James Maddison (Tottenham) for his blatant foul.
49' Ryan Manning (Southampton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
47' The Tottenham players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) is replaced by Brennan Johnson.
46' The second half has just started.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' 0 - 5 GOAL! James Maddison (Tottenham) threads the eye of the needle and scores from an almost impossible angle from close in!

45+3' Dominic Solanke (Tottenham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Darren England with no other option than to blow for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

43' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) dribbles deep into the box and releases a strike towards the left side of the goal, but Alex McCarthy makes a sensational reflex save and punches the ball onto the post. Superb goalkeeping!
40' Adam Armstrong (Southampton) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Tottenham.
39' Ryan Manning (Southampton) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Darren England no option but to blow his whistle.
37' That looked a certain handball by Radu Dragusin (Tottenham) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
36' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
36' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.

34' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper makes a superb save! Good work from Tottenham as they win a corner.
33' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
31' Ryan Manning (Southampton) puts a poor free kick into the box that Fraser Forster easily collects.
30' Lucas Bergvall (Tottenham) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
30' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) makes a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
28' Ange Postecoglou is forced to make a change. Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Pedro Porro.
27' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
25' 0 - 4 Fantastic team goal! Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) was set free in the area by Heung-Min Son and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 0:4.
22' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Destiny Udogie (Tottenham).
21' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) has a shot blocked, it rebounds back to him, but even on his second attempt he cannot hit the target. His effort goes well wide.
21' James Maddison (Tottenham) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
20' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
20' The resulting set piece from Tottenham is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

19' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Tottenham.
18' Darren England blows his whistle. Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) commits a foul after dangerous play.

17' What a save from Fraser Forster! Adam Armstrong (Southampton) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
15' Rough tackle by Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Substitution. Nathan Wood (Southampton) on for Kamaldeen Sulemana.
14' 0 - 3 Goal! The rebound fell to Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:3.
13' Mateus Fernandes (Southampton) commits a rough foul. Darren England stops the game and makes a call.
12' 0 - 2 Goal! Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) fires the rebound into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:2.

11' Tottenham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities. Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 32:68.
9' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) takes the corner but it's cleared.
9' Destiny Udogie (Tottenham) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' The referee blows his whistle as Joe Aribo (Southampton) was too aggressive in his challenge.
4' Ryan Manning (Southampton) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
3' The Tottenham players are exchanging some short passes.
1' 0 - 1 Goal James Maddison (Tottenham)! James Maddison (Tottenham) was put through by Djed Spence and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the back of the net. 0:1.
